description: One-line onboarding: creates an IDPHANTOM account for the configured payer wallet, pays the $2 USDC registration with a locally-signed EIP-712 authorization and returns the api_key. Requires PHANTOM_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY and PHANTOM_ROUTER_ADDRESS in the environment. The api_key is shown exactly ONCE in this response — store it as PHANTOM_API_KEY immediately. Without a payer key configured, pass payer_wallet to get manual instructions instead.

name.description: Optional display name for the account (default 'phantom-agent').

payer_wallet.description: Manual mode (no PHANTOM_PAYER_PRIVATE_KEY): your EVM address; the tool returns the registration challenge plus step-by-step signing instructions.

poll_interval_ms.description: Auto mode: poll interval for the registration status (default 3000).

timeout_ms.description: Auto mode: max wait for on-chain confirmation (default 180000).

name: phantom_register

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.

title: Register an IDPHANTOM account (self-serve)
